collection.description: The leader claims a dream revealed where to dig a well.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: The {@chief} claims a dream revealed where to dig a well.

choices.label: Let a young scientist test the soil.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: Fresh water is found, deepening the {@chief}'s confidence.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The villagers find only dry stone and begin to doubt.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The elder offers comfort and suggests a different place.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The elder agrees with the {@chief}, but the ground remains dry.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The apprentice identifies damp ground nearby.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The tests are inconclusive, and the village remains thirsty.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The villagers find a promising site without proving the dream's meaning.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The work is delayed by disagreement over whose guidance mattered.
